erica: Quick heads-up — ran the RoPE variant sweep across Mixtral-8k / Qwen-14B for longctx (32k -> 256k). Using linear / NTK / YARN banks. Observed a sharp perplexity cliff for Mixtral when using NTK at ~70k tokens, quality drops and output repeats. Anyone seen this pattern?
ben: Interesting. Can you paste the exact model config and the kernel selection logs?
erica: Config snippet I used for the failing runs: ```json
{"model":"mixtral-8k","rope_variant":"ntk","ntk_scale":1.2,"heads":32,"kv_head_dim":64,"quant":"fp16"}
``` Kernel routing was automatic, runtime picked `k_mm_optimized` then fell back around 65536 to `generic_attention_mm`.
mira: Reproducer? small run or full dataset? Also what batching heuristics did you have — continuous-batching on or off?
erica: Quick repro with a single long prompt (65k tokens) triggers it. Batching: continuous=true, batch_size=4, max_tokens_per_request=131072.
jordan: Perf logs I grabbed: tokens/sec drops from 11.8k @seq=32k to 1.9k @seq=70k. KV memory pressure spikes (GPU mem 95% -> 102% then OOM got avoided by fallback). Looks like kernel fallback + KV slab eviction thrashing.
perf-bot: @erica attached profile summary: top waits: headkv_memcpy (42%), kernel_compile_wait (18%), generic_mm_exec (27%).
erica: Thanks — attaching minimal trace excerpt: ```
[trace] seq=70000 kernel=generic_attention_mm time=312ms tokens=512 mem_kv=24.6GB headkv_copy=142ms
[trace] seq=32000 kernel=k_mm_optimized time=44ms tokens=512 mem_kv=9.8GB headkv_copy=18ms
```
ben: That headkv_copy jump is suspect. Could be headdim->kv layout mismatch causing per-head memcpy instead of contiguous copy. Which head layout did you use? (e.g., interleaved vs blocked)
mira: Also check the kernel selection policy thresholds in runtime_config: `kernel_thresh.seq_to_generic = 65536` might be too low for NTK variants where effective seq scaling differs.
jordan: On Mixtral we saw NTK effective scale ~1.15, so thresholds should be scaled accordingly. Suggest bumping kernel_thresh to 131072 for NTK candidates to avoid premature generic path.
erica: Tried a short rerun with kernel_thresh=131072 and kv_slab=1GB; tokens/sec stabilized (~9.1k at 70k) and no perplexity cliff on second pass. Quality improved but still slightly degraded vs linear variant.
ben: Does linear RoPE avoid the headkv memcpy? If yes, maybe runtime needs a RoPE-aware memcpy path for NTK transform.
mira: Filed a tiny runtime patch idea: prefer `k_mm_optimized` for NTK if kv_bytes_per_token < X and heads*kv_head_dim matches contiguous layout. Pseudocode: ```
if (rope_variant==NTK && kv_stride==contiguous && seq<kernel_thresh_ntk) use k_mm_optimized;```
jordan: Also we should add a perf test: longctx 128k with a micro-benchmark to assert tokens/sec >= 4k and no >30% headkv_copy time. I'll own the perf test.
erica: Action items: 1) ben -> investigate head layout and memcpy paths (PR idea). 2) jordan -> add perf regression micro-bench and thresholds. 3) mira -> propose kernel_thresh tuning by model family (Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen) + rope_variant.
ben: I'll instrument headkv memcpy to log contiguous vs per-head and dump offsets. ETA EOD.
mira: If this fixes, we should add a canary rollout to Dedicated GPUs before host release. :thumbsup:
erica: Great — thanks team. If anyone else sees NTK cliffs on other models, paste short logs here.
perf-bot: Note: incident_tickets_created=0, regression_label=rope-ntk-cliff.
